Our investment team is evaluating a Chinese logistics technology company known as '顺达物流'. We need a complete, structured due diligence report saved as `company_research_report.md`.

The report must cover: company identity and registration details, ownership structure and shareholders, subsidiaries and investments, historical changes, funding rounds, legal/judicial risks, regulatory penalties, intellectual property, government contract wins, hiring patterns, recent news, and competitive landscape.

Please use the research tools available in `/workspace/tools/` to gather information before writing the report. There appear to be multiple companies using similar names, so make sure you're researching the right entity.
